summary: Yarrow Bioscience, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock and, for certain investors, pre-funded warrants. The public offering price per share and warrant is left blank, as is the total size, so no deal terms are yet fixed. Underwriters include Jefferies, TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities and LifeSci Capital, with a 30-day option for up to an additional number of shares. The last reported sale price was $29.11 on September 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; pricing and size are the key unknowns.
